newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary banking interest rates drop in March - cbank.
newsitem.headline: Hungary banking interest rates drop in March - cbank.

text.p: Hungarian banks continued to reduce their interest rates on both deposits and loans in March, the National Bank of Hungary (NBH) said in a statement on Monday.

The average lending interest rate for maturities of up to one year dropped to 22.4 percent in March from 22.8 percent in February, while the average interest rate on deposits for these maturities dropped 0.2 percentage points to 18.2 percent, the NBH said.
The margin between deposits and loans for these maturities narrowed by 0.2 percentage points to 4.2 percent, it added.
The average lending interest rate for longer than one year maturities did not change in March, while deposit interest rates dropped 0.8 percentage points to 19.7 percent, the NBH said.
On the interbank forint market, overnight and tomnext interest rates moved between 19.9 and 24.5 percent in March, while their average rose by 0.4 percentage points to 22 percent, it said.

The turnover in these deals amounted to 631.8 billion forints in March, up by 192.9 billion forints from February, and accounted for 73.3 percent of the total turnover of the interbank forint market in March, the NBH added.
